attributes.action: Urgent Action on Dangerous Riding & Riding Standards for E-Scooters, Bicycles
attributes.additional_details:
We see daily: red lights ignored pavement use no lights/reflectors at night reckless weaving through traffic no helmets or high‑visibility clothing illegal private e‑scooters widely used.
 We call on Parliament to enforce laws properly require working lights & visibility gear ban pavement riding regulate private e‑scooters; introduce registration & basic safety awareness ensure equal safety for all road users.
 Responsible riders are welcome but dangerous behaviour must end.Our lives matter too.
attributes.background: We see daily: red lights ignored; pavement use; no lights/reflectors at night; reckless weaving through traffic; no helmets or high-visibility clothing; illegal private e-scooters widely used

rejection.details:
Much of what your petition asks for, including action against red-light violations, pavement riding and the unlawful use of private e-scooters on public roads, relates to behaviour that is already illegal. 

We're not sure what specific new action you would like the Government or Parliament to take.
